title: hive-rule resolve: request body
description: Computes the rules effective for the envelope's scope, a role and a time: Hive, then workspace, then project where the scope names one, then a rule narrowed to the task generation named, with the narrower scope winning on a subject, except over a rule it qualifies and a supersession honoured only while the superseding rule is itself in force for the scope, the role and the instant. A rule past its expiry time is excluded by the clock, before any receipt exists. Read-only.

at.description: The instant to resolve for. Absent means the command's clock. A test gives it.

task_id.description: Include rules narrowed to this task and generation.
